text:
Diego (Sales): handing BrightBridge Finance to CS. POC starts next Tue. Primary asks: SAML SSO, VPC peering for private staging, and predictable perf for month-end billing-window tests.

Maria (CS): noted. Renewal risk: procurement wants SLA language (99.9% availability) + 99th pct token latency <500ms. Budget sensitive; Dedicated depends on POC perf.

Diego (Sales): they pressed on latency in demo and requested a 3-month commit estimate.

Sam (Eng): are they sending scrubbed or near-prod traffic?

Maria (CS): Legal: PII redacted but near-prod patterns; treat as sensitive (KMS + audit).

Anya (Support): support/infra: need private staging with VPC peering and KMS. Need SAML test creds contact.

ops-bot: Deploy ticket created: private-staging-brightbridge (owner: Sam). ETA 48h.

Sam (Eng): I'll provision a small dedicated cluster (2 nodes, A10G equiv), enable private control-plane, SAML, and pre-warm KV cache tuned to their seq lengths.

Maria (CS): actions: Diego share IdP metadata + procurement contact; Sam provision infra; Anya own runbook/escalation; Maria coordinate success metrics and cadence.

Diego (Sales): uploading IdP metadata: https://drive.redwood/brightbridge/idp-metadata.xml

Sam (Eng): need sampled prompt distribution (no PII) to tune cache and chunking.

Maria (CS): requesting trimmed prompt set. Proposing 1-hour burst test Thu 03:00-04:00 PT to measure 95/99 latencies.

Anya (Support): prepping runbook and on-call rota for burst. Include fallback to hosted model variant and scale knobs.

Maria (CS): runbook bullets: monitor per-route 99th latency; if >500ms flip canary fallback to open-compat variant; notify account team and exec sponsor.

Sam (Eng): infra config to apply:
``
cluster_name: brightbridge-dedicated
nodes: 2
gpu_type: A10G
prewarm_kv_cache: true
kv_cache_retention: 6m
saml_enabled: true
slo_99_latency_ms: 500
logging: audit+metrics
```

Diego (Sales): procurement wants rough 3-month commit numbers.

Maria (CS): I'll draft a conservative estimate and share tomorrow. Tagging AMs re: renewal risk (budget + SLA).

Anya (Support): escalation chain: Sam primary, Anya secondary, ops-lead tertiary. I'll create #support-brightbridge and add their support contacts.

Sam (Eng): will post provisioning PR and ping thread when live. Confluence runbook link to follow.

Maria (CS): owners & next steps: Diego confirm IdP + procurement contact (today); Sam provision infra + run burst (48h); Anya create runbook + channel (tomorrow); Maria collect prompts, draft estimate, schedule Tue 10:00 PT kickoff (EOD).

Diego (Sales): procurement contact: julia.procure@brightbridge.com (shared).

Maria (CS): finalizing kickoff doc with 30/60/90 success metrics and scheduling Tue 10am PT.

Anya (Support): need SAML test creds and BrightBridge engineer to trigger the burst.

Sam (Eng): adding runbook: https://confluence.redwood/dedicated/brightbridge-runbook; will ping when infra is live.

Maria (CS): closing loop: after provisioning and burst we'll decide on Dedicated commit. Move to weekly sync post-POC. :rocket:

Diego (Sales): handing off to CS & Support. Ping me if procurement requests alternative SLAs or shorter commit options.
